raw.query: SELECT engine, attn, n_images, mean_ms, ci95_ms, p50_ms, min_ms, ms_per_img, is_valid FROM collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px=448 AND mean_ms BETWEEN 11.3 AND 11.4
raw.observed: 448px encoder-forward means 11.304–11.385 ms, ci95 0.020–0.030 ms (sdpa/eager/compiled); no stored value 11.360 ± 0.006
raw.evidence: collector_encoder_fn (image_px=448) records ~11.3 ms with ci95 ~0.02–0.03 ms; the stated value 11.360 and its ±0.006 uncertainty are not backed (±0.006 is ~3–5x tighter than observed ci95).
raw.fix: Replace with the measured figure, e.g. 11.32 ± 0.02 ms (sdpa, n_images=1, 50 iters) or report the observed spread across engines (11.30–11.39 ms, ci95 ~0.02–0.03 ms).
